description.p: Krusader and Total Commander are quick because you work in two panels side by side and press F5 to copy from one to the other. CannonCommander brings that way of working to your own computer, with the same interface it shows on a server.

ul.li: Two panels with tabs, a command search on Ctrl+K and the function keys of a commander
Copies, moves and deletes run as jobs in the background, with pause, undo and a trash
Nine views per tab, from details to a gallery, with quick look on the space bar
Search, folder compare and sync, duplicates, disk usage, batch rename, archives and checksums
A viewer and an editor for pictures, video, audio, PDF, text and code
Colours and tags for files, frequent folders and your own key bindings

description.p: There is no account, no server of ours in between and no analytics. The Flatpak reaches every folder and drive of your computer, and it uses the thumbnails and the properties dialog of your desktop. Your programs stay outside it, so a file opens in the program your desktop picks, and Open with lets the desktop ask you which one. It does not open your terminal or offer the actions of other file managers, and your software centre brings the updates. To open folders from other programs here, pick CannonCommander as the file manager in your system settings.

description.p: The first release of CannonCommander, a two-pane file manager with background jobs, a trash and the tools of Krusader and Total Commander.
